Iteration 11 complete. **Verdict: `gold_standard_met: false`** — this pass found and fixed two major measurement-integrity holes, so the loop should run once more.

## What this iteration found

With the statistics stack already re-derived twice defect-free, fresh eyes went to the one layer never audited against its actual source: the **evaluation layer** that turns patches into the `resolved` booleans every estimator consumes. Reading the installed SWE-bench harness code (not its assumed contract) surfaced two majors:

- **T1 — infra errors silently scored as test failures.** The harness swallows *every* per-instance error (apply-fail, timeout, Docker/build flakes — including bare `Exception`) and just writes no `report.json`. Our eval driver mapped "no report" to `resolved: false`, exited 0, and wrote the resume marker — so a Docker flake became a fabricated, permanently-frozen failed draw, corrupting the Chen (n, c), H2 gains, and R5.4 off-mode candidates. Iteration 10 had explicitly (and wrongly) asserted eval steps "fail loudly." Fixed: missing reports are now **classified** from the harness's own logs — patch-apply failure and test timeout are genuine patch-attributable failed draws (recorded with `fail_reason`); anything else exits 3 *without writing the record*, so the campaign retries once then stops loudly.
- **T2 — stale-verdict reuse.** The harness returns an existing `report.json` keyed by `(run_id, model, instance)` *without re-evaluating*, and our run id was patch-content-blind — a treatment re-run with a changed patch inherited the old patch's verdict. Fixed: eval run ids now embed a SHA-1 of the patch content (which also makes post-stop retries cheap via legitimate cache hits).

Two minors also fixed: `compare()` now names predictions/eval draw-count desync (`pred_eval_count_mismatch`) instead of silently `min()`-ing it, and the figure set gains the cross-arm-valid **rarefied distinct @k\*** chart (with H1 p, power floor, and H2 gate status on the figure) — the old figure invited exactly the raw-count comparison R4.2 forbids.

## State

- 130 tests pass (121 → 130, +9), `py_compile` clean, campaign dry-run plan intact; work committed (`1cd3ed5`).
- R4.1 amended (eval-outcome integrity + stale-report immunity), recorded in `spec_amendments/applied_11_eval_outcome_integrity.md` with five rejected alternatives and the tripwire check.
- Human-only remainder: ratify the amendment, launch `run_campaign.py --go` from a clean tree, and (next iteration) audit the remaining third-party seams (dataset loader, NLI protocol) before the loop can go quiet.
